paragraphs: The M235i is the performance-oriented variant of the F22/F23 2 Series generation, sitting just below the M240i in the range. It uses the N55 — BMW's 3.0-litre straight-six turbocharged petrol engine — which was fitted across the entire production run from 2014 to 2021. The N55 is well-regarded in BMW specialist circles, generally considered a reliable and robust engine with minimal reported issues. The M235i was discontinued in 2021 when the G42-generation 2 Series launched, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The M235i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
